Question_text: Certain bacteria are important in the production of yoghurt. Live yoghurt contains these living bacteria. A small volume of live yoghurt can be added to milk and, given suitable conditions, the bacteria will change the milk into yoghurt. (a) A yoghurt-milk mixture was produced by adding 5cm³ of live yoghurt to 100cm³ of milk. The mixture was stirred well. Given suitable conditions this mixture would then form yoghurt. The consistency of the yoghurt-milk mixture was compared to the consistency of the milk and the yoghurt. The pH of each was measured. The observations are recorded in the table.
